sections.title: Rally, live
sections.intro: Racing: a big white tacho, a rally computer's reflective LCD and a strip of small dials. This is the real wallpaper, drawn in your browser by the app's own code. Tap the big gauge, and try Rally's layouts and colours.

sections.title: About Rally
sections.intro: Rally is a rally car's instruments: a big white dial in a black knurled ring over a honeycomb grille, a rally computer's reflective LCD with black segments, and a strip of small dials.

items.alt: The Rally style, as the wallpaper draws it
items.caption: Rally, drawn by the app itself

items.title: €0.99, once
items.text: Buy Rally once on Google Play and it's yours. On a new phone with the same Google account, it comes back by itself.

items.title: One dial, three jobs
items.text: The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed. Tap it on your home screen to switch, as in every style.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Customize sets Rally's colours and background, and its units, clock and warning lights.

items.title: Layouts, and your own
items.text: Most styles come in several layouts. You can also drag and resize the gauges and save your own.

sections.title: More styles
sections.intro: Every style runs live on its own page. Or try them all in your browser.

image.alt: The Glass style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Glass
items.text: A HUD: glowing cyan arcs and thin digits floating in brackets, no round gauges.

image.alt: The Cockpit style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Cockpit
items.text: An aircraft panel: caption lights, luminous drum counters and a clock on a riveted plate.

image.alt: The Harbour style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Harbour
items.text: Marine instruments: brass rope-edge bezels around navy enamel on a teak deck, a gold needle and brass-framed counters.

image.alt: The Track Night style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Track Night
items.text: A race screen: a rev ladder, the value huge on an electric-blue band, and shift lights closing in from both sides.
